name: Diagonal Distinction Repair Boundary
description: Isolates the eqW reflexive diagonal as the unique root confluence obstruction. Fork3 is minimal with one-bit collapse and guarded repairs restore confluence.

program.name: The Confluence Axis
program.summary: The equality test eqW merges two copies of one term that differ only in place: the reflexive diagonal is the one root obstruction to confluence, the disequality guard that repairs it is the greatest conservative repair and is definable by no term of the signature, and the guarded relation terminates and has unique normal forms while the unguarded closure gives eqW void void two normal forms. For first-order rewriting, non-omega-overlap with right-hand-side determinedness gives unique normal forms under the Section 7 hypothesis of Kahrs and Smith, and a three-term counterexample refutes their Lemma 64, the step the published proof of Problem 79 rests on.

oneLine: The reflexive eqW diagonal is the unique root confluence obstruction, minimally realized by the three-state Fork3 with a one-bit collapse repaired by disequality-guarded relations.
summary: The theory studies the KO7 kernel Trace with full Step, guarded SafeStep and EqGuardedStep and the equality witness eqW. It asks where root confluence fails, what minimal shape forces the failure, and which guards restore confluence. It proves the reflexive eqW diagonal is the unique root obstruction, minimally realized by the three-state Fork3 peak with unjoinable verdicts. It shows licensing collapses terminal support from two to one with a one-bit Hartley drop that transports to the KO7 local cone. It characterizes the greatest admissible repair as EqGuardedStep with disequality guard and constructor-selective confluence by frozen eqW with recD implying app, while full context closure breaks confluence and the void diagonal stays unjoined where delta-headed diagonals join.
boundary: Off the diagonal, Step is locally joinable and the difference branch is licensed by a ≠ b; on the diagonal eqW a a, void and integrate (merge a a) admit no common StepStar reduct so local join fails. The two-edge Fork3 peak marks this obstruction, and the completeness result locates root failure at IsEqWDiagonal. Guarded repairs restore confluence at the root and under frozen eqW with persistent disequality, but unrestricted context closure lets a licensed guard become diagonal and breaks confluence again.

files.summary: The file defines finitary signatures, algebras, homomorphisms and free terms with evaluation and substitution. It proves evaluation commutes with homomorphisms and a projection cannot factor through a homomorphism that collapses a pair it separates. It proves a predicate cannot be defined by a term equality with a fixed truth token when a homomorphism fixes the token, holds the predicate on a pair and breaks it after mapping, with disequality as a specialization.
files.conclusion: If a signature-preserving endomap fixes truth but collapses a predicate-positive pair whose image breaks the predicate, no free term defines that predicate.

files.summary: The file defines an exact total Boolean comparator as a total cmp with soundness and completeness for equality. It proves such a comparator yields DecidableEq by case on cmp, and conversely DecidableEq yields such a comparator via decide. A round-trip lemma shows the construction computes as decide, and a witness gives an ExactComparator on the kernel Trace.
files.conclusion: An exact total Boolean comparator on W exists exactly when W has decidable equality.

files.summary: The file defines a sound partial comparator with an abstain value none and decisiveness as never abstaining, plus a Y/N/U verdict and classify map. It proves a decisive sound partial comparator induces an exact total comparator and hence DecidableEq, while DecidableEq yields a decisive sound partial comparator. It shows Y forces equality and N forces disequality, exhibits a decisive witness on Trace, and exhibits always-abstain as sound but not decisive.
files.conclusion: A sound three-valued comparator yields decidable equality exactly when it is decisive; soundness alone does not suffice.

files.summary: This file defines local admissibility at a fixed diagonal source eqW a a as containment in Step plus retention of the reflexive verdict and local joinability. It proves every admissible relation must refuse the competing diagonal-difference edge to integrate (merge a a). It exhibits the reflexive-only repair, proves it admissible and non-vacuous, and derives its refusal of the difference edge.
files.conclusion: Every admissible repair at eqW a a refuses the diagonal-difference edge, and the reflexive-only repair shows the class is inhabited.

files.summary: This file proves disequality is the unique and greatest diagonally safe and off-diagonal complete guard, with the empty guard as independence witness. It characterizes the exact relation difference between Step and EqGuardedStep as the diagonal-difference family and records strict inclusions with SafeStep. It defines guard-free admissible repairs, proves EqGuardedStep is the unique greatest one, and forces its difference branch to recognize disequality.
files.conclusion: EqGuardedStep is the unique greatest admissible repair and forces the exact disequality guard for the difference branch.

files.summary: This file normalizes contextual joinability of the diagonal peak to reduction of the difference verdict to void. It proves a strengthened sufficiency where any a reaching a delta-headed term dissolves the fracture, with congruence closures and cone invariants for integrate and merge. It proves the full biconditional classifier, packages the proven scope, and shows both sides inhabited with proper strengthening.
files.conclusion: The contextual diagonal peak joins iff the weight reaches a delta-headed term, partitioning the carrier into join and nonjoin regions.

files.summary: This file completes the two contextual cone lemmas used by the contextual join-region characterization. It proves that integrate X reaches void under contextual closure exactly when X reaches a delta-headed term. It proves that merge a a reaches a delta-headed term exactly when a reaches such a term, using contextual merge steps and merge cancellation.
files.conclusion: Both the integrate-void cone and the self-merge-delta cone hold as if-and-only-if characterizations.

files.summary: This file defines the full context closure of the surgical EqGuardedStep repair and its confluence predicate. It introduces the witness eqW of merge void void with void, whose arguments are distinct yet joinable, and builds two routes to the normal forms integrate void and void. It proves the guarded contextual relation is not confluent, isolates disequality-guard instability, and states that contextual repair needs more than a root guard.
files.conclusion: The full context closure of EqGuardedStep is not confluent because a disequality guard is unstable under reduction, as shown by an explicit witness with two unjoinable normal forms.

files.summary: This file fixes the scope of the diagonal fork under full context closure. It proves void is contextually normal and that reducts of the void difference verdict stay in a two-element cone disjoint from void, so the void peak stays unjoined. It proves every delta-headed diagonal peak joins at void via merge cancellation and the integrate-delta rule, and packages survival plus dissolution as the fracture scope.
files.conclusion: The contextual fracture is instance-dependent, surviving at eqW void void and dissolving at delta-headed diagonals.

files.summary: This file proves the eqW reflexive diagonal is the unique source of root non-joinability for full kernel Step. It records the joinable merge overlap at merge void void and absence of recursor root overlap. It proves every non-diagonal source joins by exhaustive analysis and every diagonal source fails, packaging the iff completeness with eqW void void as canonical witness.
files.conclusion: The eqW reflexive diagonal is exactly the set of root confluence obstructions, with eqW void void as canonical witness.

files.summary: This file instantiates generic role-erasure channels at the compiled rec-succ dependency-pair extraction. It defines the induced callee function with its Step and DPPair certificate and proves the applied term differs from the callee. It encodes the reduct as frame and active occurrences, proves decoding the actual channel recovers activity, derives exogenous separation and non-factoring, and checks the explicit void R5 instance.
files.conclusion: The rec-succ DP channel decodes activity, exogenously separates frame from active, and is not value-factored with an explicit R5 instance.

files.summary: This file supplies finite witnesses for four semantic non-implications behind the diagonal-grade ledger. It gives a lossy self-evaluation law without faithful quotation, a separated universal evaluator without Bool-Unit identification, closure of all Bool endomaps without one-code universality, and a correct Bool comparator without closure of negation alone. Each pair is packaged as a reverse-separation certificate.
files.conclusion: The four diagonal-grade capabilities are separated from their converses by explicit finite witnesses.

files.summary: The file declares seven tags with semantic realizations on Trace and on supplied relation and observer data, plus proof-carrying Verdict obstructions. It proves a uniform positive transport table for D1s, D1p and D2 under observer factorization, step lifting and simulation, and code denotation preservation. It gives two finite Bool fixtures showing simulation alone does not move D1p forward and lifting alone does not reflect D2, plus seven reverse separations and four computation-rule families. It packages clauses (i) to (iv) into a finite stratification theorem stated only for the declared tags.
files.conclusion: Clauses (i) to (iv) are mechanized jointly on three structural and four dynamic tags and on no wider tag universe.

files.summary: The file defines local join at a fixed source measured in the ambient full-kernel closure. It proves void is a normal form and that void and integrate of merge a a have no common StepStar reduct. It deduces that retaining the reflexive diagonal edge plus local join at eqW a a forbids the diagonal difference edge. The module contains no maximality premise and is isolated for use by the repair.
files.conclusion: Retaining the reflexive diagonal edge together with local join rules out the diagonal difference edge.

files.summary: The file freezes copy, comparison and self-evaluation structures and gives copy and comparison witnesses on Trace. It shows ambient classical logic supplies a comparator on every carrier, refuting unconditional copy-without-comparison separation, and separates the levels instead by naturality under merging maps with a Fin 3 witness. It shows Trace is free with only the identity signature endomorphism, so the merging carrier cannot be Trace. It defines Sigma-definability and signature internality and proves no Sigma-definable universal evaluator and hence no internal self-evaluation diagonal, closed by a three-level ladder.
files.conclusion: Trace copies and compares, copying and comparison separate only by naturality on a merging carrier, and no self-evaluation diagonal on Trace is internal to the seven-constructor signature.

files.summary: The file defines the executable structural comparator structEq and proves it sound and complete for syntactic identity. It defines discOp returning the collapse point on the diagonal and proves it is the exact discriminator. It defines the executable guarded relation and proves it coincides with the disequality-guarded relation. It proves natural-under-merging extensions define no discriminator and that the comparator is minimal in the declared two-entry grammar given failure of the empty entry.
files.conclusion: One executable comparator suffices to define the discriminator and is minimal in the declared grammar.

files.summary: The file defines D0 with no license, D1s as present observer disequality, D1p as disequality persisting under all independent futures, and D2 as D1p plus an internally represented comparator. It proves the forward ladder D2 to D1p to D1s to D0 and an exact bridge identifying D1p with persistent Box under pair lifting. It shows the KO7 coalescing pair has D1s but not D1p, the stable delta-void pair has D1p and reaches D2, and the write-closed repair blocks the instability branch.
files.conclusion: D2 implies D1p implies D1s implies D0 with strictness at D1s versus D1p and D2 witnessed by the stable KO7 pair.

files.summary: The file defines observer factorization, one-step simulation and lifting, and represented-by-code with denotation-preserving code maps. It proves simulation and lifting extend to reflexive-transitive paths. It proves D1s moves both ways along factorization, D1p reflects along simulation and transports along lifting, and D2 transports between comparator languages only through an explicit code map.
files.conclusion: Static and persistent grades move exactly under the stated factorization, simulation, lifting and code-map hypotheses.

files.summary: The file defines a certified classification payload for equality modes with fork label and enum reflection. It certifies the raw unguarded totalized rewrite mode as the sole fork-carrying mode and gives no-fork certificates for the other modes, with typed comparison additionally backed by global SafeStep confluence. It proves the five-mode table complete and certifies collapse as the raw diagonal-fork case with explicit non-joinability.
files.conclusion: Exactly the raw mode forks, with collapse certified as the raw non-joinable case.

files.summary: The file defines positional constructor flags with split app sides, the positional closure and confluence predicate, and an embedding recovering the constructor-grade closure. It proves necessity of eqW freezing and both recD to appR and recD to appL with instability, B1 and recS peaks, refuting the one-sided candidate. It proves sufficiency by root-peak enumeration and local-to-global join with inherited normalization, yielding the exact two-sided characterization.
files.conclusion: Positional confluence is exactly eqW frozen with two-sided recD-to-app alignment.

files.summary: The file defines the seven-head constructor selection Ctor and the selective closure CtxOn of the surgical EqGuardedStep relation, with its star closure and confluence predicate. It transports an eqW instability peak to prove that eqW congruence breaks confluence, and exhibits a recD-thawed app-frozen peak to refute that freezing eqW alone suffices. It then proves root-peak enumeration, local joinability, Newman lifting to the corrected crown, full-thaw simulation against the compiled contextual relation, and concrete branching-and-joining witnesses.
files.conclusion: The constructor-selective equality-guarded closure is confluent exactly when eqW is frozen and recD implies app.

files.summary: The file defines record-license events and the frame and active occurrences of the duplicated KO7 generator. It proves the pair shares a Trace value but differs in role, refuses a value record while admitting a role record, and identifies that role record with the live R_rec_succ dependency-pair channel separation plus extraction certificates. The capstone conjoins these with the SafeStep guard refusal and the one-bit local-cone accounting, explicitly without proving dependency-pair soundness.
files.conclusion: The KO7 recursor yields a value-diagonal role-distinct pair whose role record is exactly the certified dependency-pair license with one bit of refusal cost.

files.summary: The file defines coordinatewise refinement over indexed diagonal grades and proves forward maps from quotation through substitution and diagonal stages to semantic truth. It proves finite failures for reverse implications such as substitution to quotation. It packages an explicit forward map and proves that quotation and semantic truth do not collapse.
files.conclusion: Quotation refines through substitution to semantic truth forward, no reverse refinement holds, and distinct grades do not collapse.

files.summary: The file defines separate indices for nine diagonal coordinates and eight grades from quotation to semantic truth, with projections for each coordinate. It proves pairing injectivity lemmas and projection values. It proves that successive grades differ on their distinguishing coordinate, so no conflated grade-two type is reused.
files.conclusion: The eight indexed diagonal grades are pairwise separated by their coordinates, from quotation to semantic truth.

files.summary: The file identifies metric grade D1u with the compiled compact-uniform separation predicate. It proves the 1/(n+1) family fails D1u despite being pointwise nonzero, separating pointwise from uniform separation. It proves D1u plus locally uniform convergence yields locally uniform convergence of reciprocals.
files.conclusion: The 1/(n+1) family is pointwise nonzero but not D1u, and D1u transports locally uniform convergence to reciprocals.

files.summary: The file is a pure import aggregation front door for the schema-first Distinction Boundary stack. It declares nothing itself. Importing it introduces no additional declaration or trust surface.
files.conclusion: Importing this module adds no declaration or trust surface.

files.summary: The file provides a public API that re-exposes the minimal-fork development with all scope hypotheses kept visible. It states a lower bound of three states for a nonjoinable one-step peak and that the three-state Fork3 attains the bound with a categorical initiality property. It gives injective fork embeddings for terminal diagonals, with preservation and reflection of the one-step relation under a determined-diagonal hypothesis, and a local-cone equivalence for determined terminal diagonals. It records termination of minimal and deep equality-witness systems together with failures of confluence or local confluence, a guarded root repair that stays confluent at the root while failing under unrestricted context, three context-stable repair routes, KO7 and independent-comparator realizations of Fork3, a two-to-one terminal-support collapse with Hartley values, a classification of semantic modes, and the crown bundle.
files.conclusion: The API records the full minimal-fork crown together with cardinality minimality, universal fork embedding, termination without confluence, scope-limited repairs, KO7 realization, one-bit collapse and mode classification.

files.summary: This file proves ARS-generic lower bounds for a nonjoinable one-step peak without assuming a comparator or TRS signature. It shows any such peak contains three pairwise distinct states, so on a finite carrier the cardinality is at least three. It shows Fork3 attains the bound and has exactly two distinct targets.
files.conclusion: Any nonjoinable one-step peak forces at least three states on a finite carrier, and Fork3 attains the bound.

files.summary: This file wraps bespoke pointed-fork morphisms in Mathlib Category and proves fork3Pointed is initial. It defines identity and diagrammatic composition and installs the category instance. It also provides nonemptiness of homs and the joint bespoke plus categorical initiality bundle.
files.conclusion: Fork3 is initial in the declared marked-fork category.

files.summary: This file defines the cardinality-minimal shape of a nonjoinable one-step peak with no KO7 syntax or equality-witness assumptions. It introduces the three-state carrier Fork3 and its two-edge relation Fork3Step. It proves both verdicts are normal, unjoinable, the source branches, source confluence fails and the carrier has size three.
files.conclusion: Fork3 is a three-state fork with two distinct normal verdicts that are unjoinable, so confluence fails at its source.

files.summary: This file proves the duck theorem between the role-separated standalone comparator and the equality-reflection comparator with different carriers and syntax. It builds the exact relation isomorphism between their marked local cones by composing each side's isomorphism to Fork3. It records bijectivity, edge preservation and reflection and the shared Fork3 obstruction.
files.conclusion: The two independently built local cones are relation-isomorphic and realize the same Fork3 obstruction.

files.summary: The file defines a Prop-valued structure that bundles the minimal-fork claims about cardinality, initiality, signatures, termination, nonconfluence, deep correspondence, universal embedding, KO7 instances, guarded scope, repairs, multiplicities, collapse, profile transport and mode classification. It proves a constructor that inhabits the bundle from previously proved lemmas, keeping root and context relations separately named and root repair separated from unrestricted contextual confluence. It also proves that the bundle at universe zero is nonempty.
files.conclusion: The production crown constructor inhabits the MinimalForkCrown bundle, so all listed cardinality, embedding, termination, nonconfluence, repair, KO7, collapse and classification claims hold together.

files.summary: This file defines terminal defect, repair-cover and witness-rank coordinates with separate meanings and computes exact quantitative profiles. It proves the raw profile is (2,1,1,1) and the licensed profile is (1,0,0,0). It proves the live KO7 raw and licensed profiles equal the canonical ones coordinate by coordinate.
files.conclusion: The raw profile is (2,1,1,1), the licensed profile is (1,0,0,0), and live KO7 profiles coincide exactly with the canonical ones.

files.summary: The file studies root-only rewriting for the minimal equality-witness system with verdicts same and different. It shows the raw root relation has two unjoinable verdict normal forms, so every diagonal query eqW(a,a) witnesses nonconfluence. It proves the guarded root relation is functional and hence confluent at every source. It characterizes the failure exactly: a raw source has two distinct one-step targets iff it is diagonal, so local joinability fails exactly there.
files.conclusion: Guarded root rewriting is globally confluent while raw root rewriting fails confluence exactly on diagonal queries.

files.summary: The file defines the unrestricted contextual closures of the raw and guarded root relations with both positions beneath eqW active. It proves raw and guarded root steps embed into the corresponding context relations. It proves the guarded context relation is a subrelation of the raw one and gives left and right congruence steps.
files.conclusion: Raw and guarded contextual closures are defined with both eqW arguments active, with guarded steps included in raw steps.

files.summary: The file shows the root guard does not survive unrestricted rewriting below eqW. It exhibits the smallest nested source eqW(eqW(same,different),different) that reaches both different directly and same after inner reduction. It proves both verdicts are guarded-context normal and hence unjoinable, so full guarded context is not confluent. It formalizes syntactic-disequality persistence and refutes it with the same coalescence.
files.conclusion: Unrestricted guarded context rewriting is not confluent and does not preserve syntactic disequality, as witnessed by the minimal nested counterexample.

files.summary: The file reifies the three-symbol two-rule system in the generic first-order rewriting library with a nonlinear reflexive rule. It defines ground encode and decode and proves exact correspondences for root steps, context steps and reachability closures. It proves strong normalization by EqW-symbol count and computes exactly four ordered critical pairs. It shows the same/different pair is unjoinable, so the generic system is terminating but not locally confluent.
files.conclusion: The custom minimal system coincides exactly with a two-rule first-order TRS that is strongly normalizing but not locally confluent, with exactly one bad critical pair up to symmetry.

files.summary: The file defines the frozen strategy that admits guarded root steps but no descent into comparison arguments. It proves frozen steps coincide exactly with guarded root steps and are included in guarded context rewriting. It proves strong normalization by query count and confluence by functionality, and preserves all legal off-diagonal verdicts.
files.conclusion: Freezing both arguments below eqW yields a strongly normalizing confluent fragment that preserves every legal off-diagonal verdict.

files.summary: The file introduces an independent diagonal-safe policy for raw root subrelations. It shows the guarded relation satisfies the policy and contains every other safe restriction, hence is the greatest such restriction. It proves off-diagonal agreement with raw rewriting and exact refusal of diagonal difference steps, with a sound and complete executable evaluator.
files.conclusion: The guarded root relation is the greatest diagonal-safe restriction of the raw relation and is executable and confluent.

files.summary: The file defines recursive canonical normalization to verdicts and a one-step normalize-before-compare relation. It proves normalization always yields a verdict and is idempotent, and the comparison is functional, count-decreasing, terminating and confluent. It proves agreement with guarded root on already-canonical arguments and stresses the strategy scope.
files.conclusion: Normalize-before-compare is deterministic, terminating and confluent, matching guarded root comparison on canonical arguments.

files.summary: The file defines persistent disequality as current plus future distinctness under all independent guarded-context reductions. It proves propagation, non-expiration, denial on diagonals and common reducts, inhabitation for same and different, and failure for the contextual counterexample. It bridges to the live Box infrastructure and defines full contextual licensed rewriting, proving inclusion, termination, quantitative local confluence and Newman confluence.
files.conclusion: Full contextual rewriting licensed by persistent disequality is strongly normalizing and confluent.

files.summary: The file defines the raw two-rule root relation and the guarded repair deleting diagonal difference steps. It proves every guarded step is raw and exhibits the closed diagonal peak with both verdicts. It proves guarded rewriting admits diagonal equal verdicts, refuses diagonal difference verdicts, and preserves off-diagonal differences, with complete classifications of both relations.
files.conclusion: The raw root relation and its guarded repair are defined and completely classified, differing only by diagonal difference steps.

files.summary: The file proves finite-role lower bounds for declared comparator grammars without putting Fintype on recursive terms. It shows role-collapsed signatures need at least three symbols and role-separated need at least five, with exact witnesses attaining both. It shows two distinct verdict emissions need two targets and two declared rule identities need cardinality two, bundling all three minima.
files.conclusion: Three collapsed roles, five separated roles and two rule identities are minimal and attainable.

files.summary: The file declares the minimal role-collapsed grammar with equal and different verdicts and binary queries. It defines the query-node count and proves the verdicts distinct. It gives closed diagonal and off-diagonal queries and a nested family witnessing arbitrarily many query nodes with exact counts.
files.conclusion: The minimal three-symbol grammar with its query-count measure and closed and nested witnesses is defined.

files.summary: The file proves every raw and guarded root and context step strictly lowers the structural query count. It gives a generic natural-measure constructor yielding strong normalization for all four relations. It proves a generic exact-length bound and instantiates it to bound every derivation by the initial query count.
files.conclusion: All four minimal relations are strongly normalizing with explicit query-count length bounds.

files.summary: This file defines the authoritative exact diagonal-fork schema storing only the one-step relation with joinability fixed to Reach R. It defines local joinability, diagonal verdict joinability, terminal-diagonal hypotheses and determinedness. It proves the schema always has the two designated diagonal exits and that joinability is reflexive and symmetric.
files.conclusion: The exact schema fixes joinability to Reach and isolates terminal and determined hypotheses for later breakers.

files.summary: This file builds the exact schema for the independent role-separated comparator reusing only its carrier and relation, not its legacy closure claim. It proves both verdicts normal, terminal certificate at base0, determinedness with no third output, exact local-join failure, injective Fork3 embedding, local-cone isomorphism and concrete peak.
files.conclusion: The independent five-role comparator has a terminal determined diagonal that fails exact local join and is Fork3-isomorphic.

files.summary: The file studies terminal-support multiplicity and Hartley information for raw and licensed fork relations. It proves that raw Fork3 terminal multiplicity at the source is two while licensed multiplicity is one, with structural Hartley collapse equal to one and raw Hartley one and licensed Hartley zero. It proves that the KO7 raw terminal-support finset is the image of Fork3 support under the proved carrier and relation equivalence, that KO7 inherits the two-to-one multiplicities by transport, and that KO7 structural collapse coincides with Fork3 structural collapse.
files.conclusion: Licensed repair reduces terminal support from two alternatives to one with structural Hartley collapse equal to one, and this profile transports to the KO7 local cone.

files.summary: This file proves both directions between kernel StepStar and quantitative exact-length Reach Step rather than identifying them silently. It shows StepStar implies Reach, Steps implies StepStar, Reach implies StepStar, hence equivalence, plus normal-form equivalence and recovery of the kernel forward theorem.
files.conclusion: Kernel StepStar and quantitative Reach coincide extensionally with matching normal forms.

files.summary: This file builds the exact local-cone bridge from canonical Fork3 to KO7, identifying only the three marked states at eqW void void with restricted relations. It defines the carrier equivalence, proves raw and licensed relation agreements, builds both isomorphisms and injective trace maps, and shows raw edges match kernel Step while licensed edges match SafeStep.

files.summary: This file instantiates KO7 as an exact diagonal-fork schema over live kernel root Step for every diagonal eqW a a. It proves void and difference verdicts normal, verdicts distinct, terminal and determined certificates, failure of local join at every diagonal with closed specialization, injective embeddings, local-cone isomorphism and concrete peak.

files.summary: This file bridges the legacy generic diagonal-fork schema storing arbitrary RStar to the exact schema fixing closure to Reach. It defines exact-to-legacy conversion, exact-closure certificates, forgetful fromLegacy, upgrade packages and proves verdict and local-join agreements across certified bridges plus terminal breaker transport both ways.

files.summary: This file proves terminal verdicts force the exact diagonal break for S.R with closure Reach S.R. It shows distinct normal diagonal verdicts are unjoinable, so local one-step joinability fails without extra nonjoinability premise. It also shows determined diagonals equate local joinability with verdict joinability.

files.summary: This file defines marked one-step forks with nonjoinable marked verdicts and morphisms preserving marks and edges. It builds the canonical Fork3 object, the mark-forced canonical map with uniqueness and injectivity from the three-distinct-states theorem, plus bespoke initiality and nonemptiness.
files.conclusion: Fork3 is bespoke-initial among marked nonjoinable forks with a unique injective canonical map into each target.

files.summary: This file is the quantitative front for the canonical minimal fork, naming the licensed repair relation. It restates raw terminal multiplicity two, licensed multiplicity one, raw Hartley one and licensed Hartley zero under stable names.
files.conclusion: The canonical raw fork has multiplicity two and Hartley one while the licensed fork has multiplicity one and Hartley zero.

files.summary: This file builds the exact schema for the equality-reflection carrier as a second independent realization, without using its legacy closure. It proves both verdicts normal, terminal and determined certificates, exact local-join failure, injective Fork3 embedding, local-cone isomorphism and concrete peak.
files.conclusion: The equality-reflection comparator independently realizes the same exact Fork3 obstruction with isomorphic local cone.

files.summary: This file adds proof-bearing canonical local surfaces for equality modes, where raw mode carries two-edge Fork3Step and non-raw modes carry one-edge licensed surface. It defines fork embeddings, containment, dispositions and certificates. It proves the raw mode contains the fork by identity, no injective copy fits into the licensed surface, every non-raw mode excludes it, and containment holds exactly for unguardedTotalizedRewrite, agreeing with the legacy label.

files.summary: This file proves every exact terminal equality-witness diagonal is a pointed nonjoinable fork with a canonical injective Fork3 map from initiality. It defines relation isomorphisms, local-cone carriers and equivalences, proves preservation always and reflection under determinedness, and derives finite-cardinality lower bounds.
files.conclusion: Every terminal diagonal contains an injective Fork3, and determined diagonals have Fork3-isomorphic local cones.

files.summary: Computes ceiling-log terminal choice bits for the Fork3 raw step as one and for the licensed step as zero, with a drop of one, and transports the raw and licensed profiles to the KO7 local cone. Proves the conjunction of Hartley-entropy drop of one and ceiling-log drop of one for Fork3 and the ceiling-log drop of one for the KO7 local cone. Records the scope wall that the collapse counts dimensionless structural bits.
files.conclusion: The Fork3 raw-to-licensed collapse drops both Hartley entropy and ceiling-log length by one, and the KO7 local cone inherits the one-bit ceiling-log drop.

files.summary: The file defines the licensed one-edge repair deleting the diagonal difference edge and proves it is a subrelation. It proves raw and licensed normalization, exact terminal supports of size two and one, multiplicities two and one, Hartley values one and zero, an exact one-bit structural collapse, source confluence of the licensed fork, and a crown bundle.
files.conclusion: The canonical fork collapses from two terminal exits and one Hartley bit to one exit and zero bits under licensing.

files.summary: The file proves steps, reachability, normal forms and terminal support transport along relation isomorphisms, giving invariance of terminal multiplicity. It derives KO7 raw multiplicity two and licensed multiplicity one from the canonical Fork3 profile. It proves agreement with existing KO7 theorems and packages the transported 2-to-1 collapse.
files.conclusion: KO7 local raw and licensed multiplicities are 2 and 1 by transport of the canonical fork collapse.

files.summary: Defines the three-state observational diagonal MapCone with a raw two-edge relation and a licensed one-edge subrelation refusing novelty. Proves the raw fork is unjoinable and not confluent, gives exact raw and licensed isomorphisms with Fork3, and composes them to live KO7 Step and SafeStep edges on three Trace states with confluent licensed repair. Adds observation pairs and record correctness, showing a decoder from observations alone exists exactly when the observer is injective and the truth restriction is confluent.
files.conclusion: The observational diagonal fork is exactly the Fork3 and live KO7 diagonal cone in raw and licensed form, with confluence repaired by refusing novelty and observability characterized by injectivity.

files.summary: Defines sound and complete disequality discriminators and naturality under an endomorphism. Proves a generic clone no-go: a natural operation under a merging, collapse-reflecting endomorphism cannot discriminate disequality, with an explicit Fin 3 witness that the hypotheses are inhabited. Proves a finite-state boundary: no bottom-up observer with finite state recognises the diagonal of the infinite kernel carrier, while an equality test decides it.
files.conclusion: No single natural term operation and no finite-state bottom-up observer defines the distinction observer, while an equality test does.

files.summary: Proves a generic Lawvere diagonal no-go: every diagonal-closed language over a fixed-point-free shift lacks a universal evaluator and the obstruction persists under extension, instantiated by the Trace Sigma language. Shows polynomial orientation behaves differently: counter-uncoupled languages are obstructed on every duplicating schema but the full language on the free schema orients via a cross-coupled polynomial. Packages both as obstruction systems to prove exact separation with nondefinability certificates for collapse versus license.
files.conclusion: Diagonal obstruction is extension-stable and polynomial orientation obstruction is not, so the two obstruction classes are separated with exact nondefinability certificates.

files.summary: Defines the greatest stable sublicense Box of a predicate along a relation and proves containment, star-closed invariance, greatestness and idempotence. Instantiates to componentwise EqGuardedStep on Trace pairs with license disequality, characterizing persistence as never coalescing under independent reduction. Exhibits a negative witness where merge void void coalesces to void and a positive witness where delta void versus void persists by normality.
files.conclusion: Box is the greatest forward-invariant subpredicate of disequality, failing exactly at the coalescing pair and holding at the normal stably distinct pair.

files.summary: Defines fixed-length binary certificates BitWord L as functions Fin L to Bool and computes their cardinality as 2^L. Proves that an injective encoding of a finite type E needs at most 2^L alternatives and at least Nat.clog 2 card E bits, with no injective code when 2^L is smaller and a specialized floor for m-1 refused alternatives. Exhibits an explicit injective two-bit code for Fin 4, shows no injective one-bit code exists, and computes Nat.clog 2 4 as 2.
files.conclusion: Every injective fixed-length binary encoding needs at least ceiling log-two bits, so four alternatives need two bits and cannot fit in one.

files.summary: Defines exact-length paths Steps, reachability Reach, normal forms, joinability, source confluence ConfluentAt and local normalization NormalizingAt for a caller-supplied relation. Proves reachability out of a normal form is constant, source confluence forces a unique reachable normal form, and uniqueness plus local normalization implies source confluence. Instantiates a two-node chain that is normalizing and confluent and a two-leaf fork whose leaves are normal but never join.
files.conclusion: Exact-length reachability supports unique normal forms under source confluence with local normalization, witnessed by a confluent chain and refuted by a non-confluent fork.

files.summary: Defines finite comparison surfaces with an emits map and a nonnull predicate, plus non-null records, diagonal soundness, off-diagonal productivity, false-positive and false-negative counts, and rational and guarded rates. Proves zero diagonal false positives characterizes soundness and zero off-diagonal false negatives characterizes productivity. Provides the exact-equality surface meeting both with zero counts, the always-different surface with diagonal count n and accuracy 1 minus 1 over n including 7 over 8 on Fin 8, and a two-point fixture with one illegal diagonal cell that is not sound.
files.conclusion: Zero error counts exactly capture diagonal soundness and off-diagonal productivity, achieved by exact equality but violated by always-different and one-illegal-diagonal fixtures.

files.summary: Exhaustively lists the three nodes of the KO7 local cone, defines a rank for canonical ordering, Boolean raw and licensed successor tests, all ordered pairs, canonically ordered peaks, raw and licensed peak lists, and a defect count of unequal pairs. Proves the Boolean tests match LocalRaw and LocalLicensed and that membership matches canonically ordered peaks and Step and SafeStep successors of the embedded source. Computes raw peaks as one pair with defect count one, licensed peaks as empty with defect count zero, and the guard removing the unique defect.
files.conclusion: The raw three-node cone has exactly one local defect peak while the guarded cone has none, so the guard removes the unique local defect.

files.summary: Defines a three-node cone EqWBreakerNode with an embedding into KO7 traces and local raw and licensed step relations at eqW void void. Proves the embedding is injective and that LocalRaw matches Step while LocalLicensed matches SafeStep, with the licensed relation a subrelation of the raw one. Records a raw diagonal peak to both verdicts and that any licensed successor of source is the reflexive verdict.
files.conclusion: Local raw steps correspond to Step and licensed steps correspond to SafeStep, with the licensed relation allowing only the reflexive verdict.

files.summary: Defines a single canonical defect, four repair actions, the full bad set, a closes map sending every action to the full set, and a tabulated action cost. Proves the full family covers the defect and that the repair cover number equals one via a singleton guard cover and a counting lower bound. Proves the guard action is the unique minimum-cost action.
files.conclusion: The canonical KO7 defect needs exactly one repair and the guard action is its unique cheapest repair.

files.summary: Transfers the generic terminal-support and multiplicity framework to the KO7 local raw and licensed relations at source. Proves local normalization for both, computes raw support as two verdicts and licensed support as one, hence multiplicities two and one. Computes raw Hartley entropy one, licensed entropy zero, and structural collapse one.
files.conclusion: KO7 raw reachability has terminal multiplicity two and entropy one while licensed reachability has multiplicity one and entropy zero for a collapse of one.

files.summary: Defines a threshold adequacy fixture where grades at least one are adequate. Shows grade zero is inadequate and grade one is adequate, so the witness rank equals one. Notes explicitly that no adapter connects the checked nonderivability declaration to this threshold.
files.conclusion: The grade-at-least-one fixture has distinction witness rank one.

files.summary: Defines a PrefixBudget record with a symbol-count label and rational used and maximum masses, and validity as zero le used le max le one. Proves validity implies used mass at most one. Provides a two-symbol unit budget with both masses one and proves it valid, with no definition of codewords, lengths, prefix-freeness or link between symbol count and masses.
files.conclusion: The two-symbol unit mass budget is valid and every valid budget uses mass at most one.

files.summary: Defines repair covers, candidate families, minimum cover number, counting bounds, singleton repairs, weighted cost and minimum cost for finite defects and interventions. Proves an upper bound by any cover, a k-times-M counting bound, a ceil-division lower bound, singleton upper bounds and equality under at-most-one coverage, and a weighted optimum bounded below by the unweighted number. Exhibits a shared guard covering two defects with number one refuting naive defect equality and a ten-defect three-per-intervention case requiring four.
files.conclusion: Minimum repair covers obey counting upper and ceil-division lower bounds, with shared coverage able to beat defect count and capped coverage forcing at least four for ten defects at three per intervention.

files.summary: Defines terminal support, multiplicity, Hartley entropy, ceiling log, licensed subrelations and structural collapse, proving confluence equals multiplicity one and entropy zero equals confluence under local normalization. Instantiates a confluent chain of multiplicity one, a fork of multiplicity two and entropy one, and a four-way fork of multiplicity four collapsing to one with log ratio two under a one-edge licensed subrelation. Provides an escape system with a normal terminal plus a looping state showing multiplicity one without normalization does not imply confluence.
files.conclusion: Under local normalization source confluence is equivalent to terminal multiplicity one and zero entropy, and this premise cannot be weakened as shown by the escape system.

files.summary: Defines upward-closed graded adequacy profiles and witness rank as the least adequate grade via Nat.find, with adequacy at the rank, minimality, persistence above, antitonicity under gradewise preservation, and scope walls for profiles with no adequate grade. Provides a rank-zero always-adequate base profile, a rank-one licensed profile adequate exactly from one, an empty wall profile, and rank one distinct from zero.
files.conclusion: Witness rank is the least adequate grade, giving rank zero for always-adequate, rank one for licensed, and a wall for never-adequate profiles.

files.summary: Proves the two-sided repair dichotomy that a locally confluent repair keeping the reflexive verdict either refuses the difference edge or joins the verdicts, with restriction repairs forced to refuse. Declares a six-entry repair grammar with four modes and proves grammar-relative classification and completeness. Adds a repair lattice with a unique maximal clique on the diagonal fiber, completion pricing that joining forces new steps and uniform completion collapses integrate, and an exhaustive trichotomy with inhabited refusal branch.
files.conclusion: Every locally confluent diagonal repair refuses or joins with the join side priced by new steps, classified by a complete four-mode grammar.

files.summary: Carries the duplicating-recursor situation as occurrences with role erasure, proving collapse merges distinct frame and active copies with vacuous reflection at an active collapse point. Instantiates the clone no-go to rule out role-blind discriminators and proves activity does not factor through value. Shows any activity-decoding channel separates value-identified occurrences, while Bool values retain a discriminator, locating the obstruction in the role coordinate.
files.conclusion: Role erasure realizes the clone no-go on occurrences while values retain a discriminator, making the license external to value observation.

files.summary: Defines nodeCount counting constructors and signed nodeDelta in Int, and computes the delta for each of the eight root Step rules, with six negative rows and two positive rows. Proves the duplicator row is unbounded via delta-towers and the record row has delta one, names the rules with RuleName and RuleInstance, and proves Step coincides with the eight schemas. Defines Census classes with the censusOf table and proves the table is forced by the deltas, yielding a partition of every Step into erasing or growing cases with no neutral step. Shows the limitation that a one-node write occurs for both growing families.
files.conclusion: The eight kernel rules split into six erasing rows, a record row of delta one and an unbounded writing row, with every growing Step belonging to the latter two families and single-step delta unable to tell those two families apart.

files.summary: The file defines the constructor-selective closure that enables every congruence except eqW, thawing delta while keeping equality frozen, with SafeDelta and its reflexive-transitive closure. It proves SafeDelta is strongly normalizing as a subrelation of the guarded closure, characterizes blocked shapes via deltaFlag and kappaM, and carries out root-versus-congruence and congruence-versus-congruence local joins. By Newman’s lemma it concludes SafeDelta is confluent, identifies this with the named congruence-confluence conjecture, and notes the delta-free SafeStepCtx was already confluent.
files.conclusion: Contextual SafeStep with delta congruence thawed and eqW frozen is strongly normalizing, locally joinable, and hence confluent, strictly extending SafeStepCtx.

files.summary: The file restricts to the two full-kernel edges from eqW a a, reflexive collapse to void and diagonal difference to integrate-merge, and encodes retention choices as finite Boolean policies. It proves Boolean admissibility, retain reflexive and refuse difference, is equivalent to semantic admissibility as subrelation of Step with reflexive retention and local join. It shows the reflexive-only canonical policy is the greatest admissible policy, lifts this to relations supported on the fiber via finite encoding, and packages admissible repairs as a thin finite preorder where the canonical repair is terminal, with a deflationary monotone idempotent guard.
files.conclusion: The reflexive-only canonical policy is the greatest admissible policy on the exact two-edge diagonal fiber and the terminal object of finite critical repairs.

files.summary: The file defines equality comparison modes and classifies diagonal forking as exactly the unguarded totalized rewrite mode. It defines semantics-preserving subrelations of Step that keep all SafeStep branches, respect deltaFlag and kappaM payload guards, and refuse diagonal difference verdicts. It proves SafeStep satisfies the obligations and that any such subrelation is contained in and hence equal to SafeStep, so SafeStep is the maximal semantics-preserving repair.
files.conclusion: SafeStep is exactly the maximal semantics-preserving Step subrelation that keeps all safe branches while respecting payload guards and refusing diagonal difference.

files.summary: The file defines an abstract substitution-invariance obstruction in which a constant-collapse homomorphism identifies distinct witnesses that an external license separates. It exhibits the distinction-axis instance with sigma-term evaluator collapsing void and delta-void while identity disequality separates them, and the orientation-axis instance with DP collapse to void while a counter projection separates recursor terms of depth zero and one. It proves both instances jointly inhabit the shared shape with genuine witnesses, so the two non-derivabilities are two faces of one root with different license predicates.
files.conclusion: Both the distinction and orientation non-derivabilities are non-vacuous instances of one substitution-invariance obstruction with different external licenses.

files.summary: The file builds the diagonal matrix of an arbitrary formula on the coded substitution relation and its self-instantiated diagonal sentence, proving the general diagonal lemma for truth in the standard model and that the sentence is closed. It defines truth-definability and proves Tarski’s theorem that no formula defines truth on sentences via the liar-style diagonal of negated truth. It adds a control showing the formula x equals the code of the Gödel sentence separates the Gödel pair and agrees with truth there, packaged with Tarski’s theorem as the joint goal.
files.conclusion: Truth for sentences is undefinable in the checker’s arithmetic, though the Gödel pair is definably separable.

files.summary: This file defines sound and complete Boolean equality comparators and their conjunction IsCheck. It proves any two checks agree pointwise and coincide with the decidable-equality decision procedure, with constant-true and constant-false examples showing both obligations are needed. It proves a factored check forces its abstraction map to be injective, and derives impossibility for finite-state, bounded-depth truncation, fixed-range hashing, payload-blind, and clone-shaped maps, while showing the structural comparator structEq is the canonical check. It packages these as a five-leg one-check boundary linking repair, uniqueness, losslessness, unwritability in the seven-constructor signature, and the extended-signature comparator.
files.conclusion: Every sound and complete Boolean equality comparator coincides with the diagonal characteristic function and must read its inputs through an injective map, so no finite-state, bounded-depth, hashed, or payload-blind shortcut is a check while the full-depth structural comparator is the canonical check.

files.summary: This file defines pointwise inclusion of positional selections, write-closed selections, and the writeClosure operator that adds appL and appR whenever recD is thawed. It defines freezeEqW and the canonical confluenceRepair as freeze-then-close, proving the repair freezes eqW, is write-closed, confluent for the live equality-guarded step, and least among confluent extensions. It computes the closure on the recD-only seed, showing the raw seed is not confluent while its closure is, with distinct histories collapsing to the same repair.
files.conclusion: Freezing eqW and closing under the recD to appL and appR dependency yields the least confluent repair, turning the non-confluent recD-only seed into a confluent selection.

files.summary: This file measures the six-step licensed-ascent comparison category. It proves any two realized profiles of the same family are stagewise equivalent and that compatibility with the dependency-pair profile is exactly six realized stages plus the reflection tag. It builds the contentless all-True profile with witnesses both ways to the distinction profile, shows hom-sets are subsingletons, and bundles these as the identity-is-classification theorem.
files.conclusion: The six-step identity classifies by family tag and six truth values with subsingleton hom-sets and transports no witness data.

files.summary: The file defines a collapse boundary operator that sends every in-domain optional-trace input to a single verdict while discarding payload, and proves it satisfies the partiality, irreversibility, gauge-covariance, channel, payload-discarding and cost-floor laws. It defines boundary morphisms with identity and composition, then instantiates the collapse operator as distinction and orientation boundaries with verdicts void and delta void. It defines the verdict swap from Equiv.swap and two inverse morphisms that are the identity on queries and the swap on verdicts. It proves the two boundaries are isomorphic as boundary operators, with an explicit honest-scope note that the isomorphism captures collapse structure rather than full rewrite dynamics.
files.conclusion: The distinction and orientation boundaries are isomorphic objects in the category of boundary operators through the verdict-swapping morphisms.

files.summary: This file adds an information-theoretic overlay at the eqW breaker. It defines verdictBits as 0 for at most one verdict and 1 otherwise, noting it agrees with log2 only at 1 and 2. It proves the raw breaker carries two unjoinable verdicts, packages a diagonal refusal certificate of constant size, and bundles the one-bit collapse from 2 to 1 in the BranchEntropyCollapse record.
files.conclusion: The eqW breaker realizes a one-bit branch-entropy collapse paid by diagonal refusal.

files.summary: This file mechanizes the general real-valued branch entropy as log base 2 of the verdict count. It proves values at 1 and 2 are 0 and 1, monotonicity in the count, and that the 2-to-1 collapse drops exactly one bit. It proves agreement with the integer verdictBits at 1 and 2 and connects the eqW breaker to the n equals 2 and n equals 1 instances.
files.conclusion: General log2 branch entropy is monotone with a one-bit 2-to-1 collapse realized at the eqW breaker.

files.summary: This file defines forbidden branches and the licensed-completion transaction object with selected licensed branch, license object, refusal certificates and local-join field. It proves the diagonal raw R_eq_diff branch to integrate merge is refused by SafeStep while R_eq_refl to void is selected, giving an inhabited forbidden-branch witness. It constructs the KO7 branch transaction at eqW void void with the diagonal-empty distinction license and proves SafeStep embeds in Step.
files.conclusion: The KO7 diagonal transaction keeps void, refuses integrate merge, and restores local join under external license.

files.summary: This file supplies termination-side evidence for cross-axis comparison using the payload projection of the reflected direct grammar. It builds a payload-only and a counter-plus-payload semantic measure, proves the latter orients iiRecursor while remaining counter-dominated so no decisive support exists, and keeps the fixed-duplicator refusal independent with no relation transport. It packages refusal evidence, defines a classifier emitting T3 confession when refusal exists and T4 abstention otherwise, and proves both axes share the T3 constructor while full outputs differ.
files.conclusion: Termination and confluence refusals share only the T3 confession constructor, not full outputs.

files.summary: This file instantiates the abstract diagonal-fork schema at a standalone comparator system with no KO7 reference. It builds carrier Tm with eq, diff, base points and binary cmp, one-step Rel with reflexive cmp to eq and totalized cmp to diff, its closure and normal-form analysis proving eq and diff unjoinable. It proves cmp varies, the difference rule fires on every pair, local confluence fails at cmp base0 base0, and exhibits the concrete diverging peak.
files.conclusion: The totalized comparator realizes the diagonal-fork genus with local confluence failing at the diagonal.

files.summary: This file casts the distinction boundary as a six-step licensed-ascent profile with reflection family. Each stage is discharged by a mechanized eqW theorem, from base reductions through diagonal obstruction, unjoinability, classical gauge choice, SafeStep restoration and guard reimport. It proves compatibility with the dependency-pair profile, derives DP structural identity via the existing comparison theorem, and exhibits inverse comparison morphisms with bidirectional realization transport.
files.conclusion: The distinction boundary realizes DP structural identity as a reflection-family licensed ascent.

files.summary: This file isolates the benign-control contrast for the eqW fork on the full kernel Step. It proves every Step from merge void void lands on void and hence merge void void is locally joinable, while eqW void void is not, so non-left-linearity is necessary but not sufficient. It records SafeStep removes exactly the diagonal R_eq_diff instance while preserving all off-diagonal eqW joins, and pins eqW void void as a closed witness built from void.
files.conclusion: Merge control stays joinable while eqW forks, and SafeStep surgically removes only the diagonal.

files.summary: This file sharpens the diagonal-fork breaker into a characterization plus recovery routes. Under diagonal determinacy it proves local join at E a a holds iff the two diagonal verdicts join, and for a guarded schema with difference rule restricted off-diagonal it proves local join is recovered, with delete and quotient corollaries. It gives a concrete guarded instance over Trace with eqW, void and integrate merge, re-exports the unguarded obstruction, and bundles obstruction plus recovery as the distinction-witness boundary.
files.conclusion: Diagonal local confluence is equivalent to verdict joinability, obstructed unguarded and recovered guarded.

files.summary: This file adds functorial dynamics over the collapse boundary as companion to BoundaryDuality. It defines rewrite-to-boundary functors with object map and step-preservation, builds the generic collapse functor sending every edge to a verdict equality, and instantiates it for full Step and guarded SafeStep to both distinction and orientation boundaries. It proves transport of the eqW critical pair and guarded branches and proves the distinction functor is non-faithful while full and guarded collapse-preserving functors exist.
files.conclusion: Collapse-preserving dynamical functors exist for full and guarded dynamics but are never faithful.

files.summary: This file records the canonical eqW void void gauge anomaly for the full kernel. It defines the critical-pair record with two root steps and unjoinability. It proves eqW void void steps to void and to integrate merge void void, proves those normal forms are unjoinable, and packages local confluence failure at eqW void void.
files.conclusion: Full-kernel local confluence fails at eqW void void via two unjoinable normal forms.

files.summary: This file gives a third finite diagonal-fork instance modeled on equality reflection. It builds TyTerm with refl and impossible-diseq verdicts and idQuery, a relation with reflexive and totalized reflected-diseq rules, its closure and normal-form analysis proving verdicts unjoinable. It instantiates the schema and derives local confluence failure at the diagonal.
files.conclusion: Equality reflection realizes the diagonal-fork genus with local confluence failing at the diagonal.

files.summary: This file defines comparison interfaces with sound and complete difference verdicts and distinction generators that register distinctions exactly off the diagonal. It shows every carrier has an external comparison interface and that a decidable interface yields DecidableEq and an exact comparator. It proves sound comparison never emits difference on the diagonal, while an internalized unguarded totalized equality witness forks exactly when its two verdicts do not join. It exhibits guarded, delete and quotient repairs that restore joinability and proves not every equality-witness interface forks, with KO7 eqW as the minimal unguarded instance.
files.conclusion: Comparison is necessary and universally available, but only the internalized unguarded totalized mode forks on the diagonal while guarded interfaces provide explicit counterexamples to universal failure.

files.summary: This file defines payload-faithful dynamical boundary functors and proves a general no-go: a functor whose object map covers the boundary domain is never payload-faithful because image recovery would contradict payloadDiscarding. It instantiates the no-go for the full-kernel distinction and orientation functors and the guarded distinction functor, and shows the collapse functors are verdict-constant. It also proves the generic image-section characterization that a projection has an exact section iff it is injective.
files.conclusion: No payload-discarding boundary admits a covering payload-faithful dynamical functor, in particular not the distinction and orientation collapse functors.

files.summary: This file packages an off-diagonal disequality as SafeStepGuard and DistinctionLicense, shows they interconvert and that no license exists on the diagonal. It stores an external equality-or-disequality choice separately. It re-exports the local-join theorem that the guard restores local confluence at eqW a b.
files.conclusion: The disequality guard restores local confluence at eqW a b off the diagonal.

files.summary: This file abstracts the eqW void void breaker into a reusable diagonal-fork schema with overlapping reflexive and difference rules. It proves the generic breaker that non-joinable verdicts imply local-confluence failure at the diagonal source. It instantiates the schema to KO7 Step and StepStar and re-derives the concrete failure at eqW void void from the existing non-joinability witness without re-proving it.
files.conclusion: Any diagonal-fork schema fails local confluence at E a a when its verdicts do not join, hence full Step fails at eqW void void.

files.summary: This file pairs a hard no-go with its constructive repair for the eqW diagonal. It shows both kernel rules fire at eqW a a to distinct normal forms, so local join is impossible with the unguarded relation. It organizes conceivable repairs and discharges only the guard route, where the SafeStep a ≠ b guard restores local confluence.
files.conclusion: Keeping both diagonal verdicts is incompatible with local confluence, while the SafeStep disequality guard alone restores it.

files.summary: This file instantiates the generic finitary-algebra obstruction on the exact seven KO7 constructors. It builds the signature, algebra and genuine substitution homomorphisms, including the variable-collapse map that identifies varA and varB while fixing delta void. It proves no term defines disequality by equality with that truth token and retains the historical void-test theorem separately.
files.conclusion: Disequality is not term-definable by equality with delta void over the exact seven KO7 constructors.

files.summary: The file models KO7 rule schemas with metavariables b, s, n and a and terms over seven constructors, counting occurrences with occ and defining left-nonlinearity and right-duplication. It proves eqW a a is left-nonlinear and the successor recursor rule is right-duplicating, packaging the shared double-occurrence fact as a uniform dichotomy. It bundles the dual nonlinearity with the real unjoinable fork at eqW void void as RawMechanismCorrespondence and proves the KO7 instance. It proves right-duplication does not force nontermination since the duplicating recursor lives in a globally well-founded reverse step relation, and packages the complete boundary.
files.conclusion: The two KO7 boundary rules are dual repeated-variable instances whose confluence fork is real yet whose termination-side duplication coexists with global reverse well-foundedness.

files.summary: This file requires concrete evidence at the KO7 diagonal with retained safe and refused branches and restored join. It defines refused-edge certificates and a classifier selecting T3 confession exactly on that property and T4 abstention otherwise. It proves concrete evidence drives the classifier to confession and that confluence and termination share only the T3 schema, not full outputs.
files.conclusion: Concrete SafeStep diagonal evidence drives the semantic classifier to T3 confession with the exact refused edge retained.

files.summary: This file defines the SigmaTerm algebra mirroring the seven kernel constructors with two variable leaves and its substitution evaluator. It classifies leaf versus non-leaf heads and proves non-leaf evaluations never yield void. It packages structural induction and the distinct witness pair void versus delta void.
files.conclusion: Non-leaf Sigma terms never evaluate to void while leaves evaluate to their substitutions, supporting case analysis on term heads.

files.summary: This file packages a critical-pair proof with external-choice data and an arbitrary proposition. Its first theorem returns only the imported unjoinable fork, choice nonemptiness and arithmetic triviality without constructing any fracture or depth-zero-witness absence. Its second theorem projects the disequality already stored in SafeStepGuard without proving origin or uniqueness.
